period_note: Half-Yearly filing: the bank does not publish a discrete Q2-only statement, only a 'CONDENSED PROFIT AND LOSS ACCOUNT (Un-audited) For the Period (Q-2) From 01 January 2022 to 30 June 2022' -- balance sheet is the 30-June-2022 period-end snapshot (reported), Solo/standalone, Shariah-based Islamic bank ('Investments' not 'Loans and Advances'). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January (H1-cumulative), flagged via the _cumulative suffix; the filing's own table ALSO prints a separate discrete 'April'22-June'22' column, captured here as the _discrete_quarter fields. Source PDF ('Half_Yearly_FS_2022_____.pdf', filed with a 'Date: 24 July 2022' signature block) is a SCANNED IMAGE document -- pdftotext's embedded text layer was unusable (severely corrupted/broken font encoding), so pages were independently OCR'd (pdftoppm 300dpi + tesseract). Balance-sheet identity reconciles exactly on the OCR'd figures: Total Liabilities (227,830,542,941) + Total Equity (15,045,521,884) = Total Assets (242,876,064,825). P&L chain reconciles exactly: Total Operating Income (3,310,942,419) - Total Operating Expenses (1,583,370,635) = Profit before Provision and Tax (1,727,571,784); - Total Provisions (335,500,000) = Total Profit before Tax (1,392,071,784); - Tax (621,678,588) = Net Profit after Tax (770,393,196) -- this Net Profit after Tax figure is independently cross-validated to the Taka against Union Bank's own 2023 Q2 filing, which reproduces 'Jan'22-June'22' as its prior-year comparative (770,393,196, exact match). Discrete Q2-2022-alone figures (Profit before Tax 751,032,961; Net Profit after Tax 429,354,373; EPS 0.44) are directly OCR'd from the filing's own 'April'22-June'22' column and independently confirmed by subtraction (H1 cumulative minus this dataset's own 2022_Q1.json Q1 figures reproduces the same values exactly). 'Investments Income' (gross, pre-netting) was not legibly OCR'd from this filing's own P&L page (a table-layout artifact dropped that specific cell); the value used here (9,525.10m) is instead cross-referenced from Union Bank's own 2023 Q2 filing's 'Jan'22-June'22' comparative column, where it IS legible -- flagged basis 'reported_cross_referenced'. 'Profit Paid on Deposits' (9,525.10m minus Net Investment Income 2,675.26m = 6,849.84m) is therefore basis 'calculated_from_pl_components', not directly read. This report's own December-2021 comparative balance-sheet column matches this dataset's stored FY2021 annual figures exactly -- no restatement. The condensed quarterly filing does NOT disclose classified investments, NPL ratio, or CRAR/capital-adequacy figures.
